findings.location: row weirdml::2 version/metric/description vs SOURCE 1 protocol page
findings.evidence: Row claims version '2' and metric 'Average Max Accuracy: ... averaged over all 17 tasks'. SOURCE 1 states 'WeirdML v3' featuring '11 complex hand-made tasks' and that the official score is '80% normalized area under its line on a logarithmic token axis' with effective scores, while row describes a 5-iterations-per-run max test accuracy over 17 tasks. Page also lists 'Previous versions: WeirdML v2 - WeirdML v1', making v3 the current release. Criterion c1 forbids silently reusing the existing identity when the release version and task set changed; the row's version, task count and metric all contradict the current protocol.
findings.repair: Align the row to the current protocol: set version to the page's current release '3', and rewrite metric/task-count to the page's 11-task normalized-area scoring, or re-scope the row to the frozen v2 methodology and mark it not current (see finding 2). Do not pair v2 identity with the active v3 board.

findings.evidence: Row sets status 'active' and version_status 'published' for version '2'. SOURCE 1 shows the board currently titled 'WeirdML v3' with 'Previous versions: WeirdML v2 - WeirdML v1', i.e. v2 is a previous release replaced going forward, and the page's live release identifier is v3, not '2'. SOURCE 2 (2 values added/changed) affirmatively shows the maintainer still reports results, but for the v3 board; it does not make '2' the currently published identifier. Thus the row's status and the version/version_status pairing conflict with the protocol text.
findings.repair: Either set status to 'retained' for the v2 row (protocol shows v2 replaced by v3; keep already collected values) with version_status 'retained', or re-point the row to v3 as the active published version. A 'published' version_status is only consistent when the version matches the identifier the page currently publishes.

uncertainties: I am read-only and cannot recompute SHA-256 hashes or run transport/qualification checks; row hash binding and owner qualification receipt are taken as given.
SOURCE 1 is a bounded excerpt; the full results payload/table body was not reproduced, but the version, task count and scoring statements needed for these findings are present.

Ambiguity: the registry id 'weirdml::2' could intend a frozen v2 methodology rather than the current v3 page; either reading still makes the current row internally inconsistent because it mixes a v2 methodology with active/published current-board claims.
